item.tib: ma mo gsang ba'i thugs sgrub zhal zas tshogs kyi mchod pa
item.coloph: ces pa'i srid rgyal tshogs mchod 'di ni gtsang phyogs zhu tshang g.yung 'brang phyug mo nas gsang sngags glang (gling) pas gter du drang (drangs) shing phyis lo ngo bcu gsum bka' rgya bkral nas mkha' 'gro dbang mo dang mchog sprul g.yung drung 'dra bla'i bla ma g.yung drung dbang rgyal g.yung drung rgyal mtshan skal bzang dbang rgyal sogs kyis bskul ngor gsang sngags gling pas mkha' 'gro'i brda ris bod yig tu phab pa'o//
